description: User-selected lifestyle goals used as explicit intent within the PWB recommendation model. Goals are deliberately separated from outcomes, which represent the structured physiological targets used by the scoring engine.

selection.uiInstruction: Select up to 3 areas that are most important to you right now.
selection.selectionWeighting: Not yet defined. Initial scoring tests should determine whether selected goals are equal-weighted or ordered by priority.

goals.name: Better Sleep
goals.description: Improve sleep quality and restorative recovery.

goals.name: Weight Management
goals.description: Support healthy weight and body composition.

goals.name: Better Fitness
goals.description: Improve physical fitness, strength, stamina and exercise performance.

goals.name: Better Digestion
goals.description: Support digestive comfort, regularity and gut health.

goals.name: Mental Clarity
goals.description: Support concentration, focus and cognitive performance.

goals.name: Mobility & Joints
goals.description: Support mobility, joint function and comfortable movement.

goals.name: Stress Resilience
goals.description: Support resilience and the ability to cope with everyday stress.

goals.name: Healthy Ageing
goals.description: Support resilience, function and wellbeing as you age.

goals.name: Menopause Support
goals.description: Support wellbeing and resilience during the menopause transition.

goals.name: Heart Health
goals.note: No dedicated outcome is created yet. This goal should not enter scoring until an appropriate outcome has been defined.

goals.name: Immune Resilience
goals.description: Support healthy immune function and resilience.
goals.note: No dedicated outcome is created yet. This goal should not enter scoring until an appropriate outcome has been defined.
